_readme: Operator TREND-END + AUTOMATIC-REACTION marks, provided 2026-08-14 (chat,
three hand-drawn charts + a written ruling per render of the
AR_FIRST_REACTION_ENABLED eyeball set).
Deliberately OUTSIDE docs/marks/ (the sealed must-fire corpus): these are
CALIBRATION ground truth for the Phase-A anchor and for segment_trends'
terminal_bar, not must-fire specs. Same immutability discipline as
docs/phase_c_marks_2026-07.json: APPEND-ONLY, operator corrections only. A
failing case is fixed in the ENGINE, never by editing a mark.
WHAT THE OPERATOR IS MARKING (his words, 2026-08-14): 'The point of this is
finding the Last Trending Before the Consolidation starts and that's why they
go hand in hand.' He marks a transition ZONE, not two independent events: the
last trend peak, and the low 1-5 bars later where the base opens. On three
charts he states the identity outright - the AR low IS the root swing IS where
the consolidation starts. Whether he calls a given engine dot 'the climax' or
'the AR' depends on which end of that short zone it landed on.
HIS OWN CAVEAT, recorded because it bounds how hard these may be leaned on:
'this exercise gets confusing quickly since the Engine Finds the end of one
Trend but then another counter trend starts ... and only then the true
consolidation starts. I find it to be quite hard to rule on all of these since
there isn't one concrete answer Im 100% sure is correct, their just very ugly
structures (most of them) so i cant be sure.' Treat these as a direction of
travel with 9 dated points, NOT as a sealed acceptance set.
Dates were given in European DD/MM form and are resolved here to ISO. The year
is inferred from the rendered window (the last ~260 bars of the faithful 2y
frame, i.e. 2025-08..2026-08); every resolved pair yields a 1-5 bar span,
which is the consistency check that the inference is right.
trend_end_source=derived marks a trend_end the operator did NOT type: on AMH,
INVH and LMNR he pointed at an engine dot and named what that point IS, and
the date was read back off that dot (ar_off, which equals box.start_bar).
Those three are legitimate marks but CIRCULAR as a test of the engine - they
are derived from the engine's own output, so scoring segment_trends or the
climax against them measures the engine against itself. tools.operator_marks_diff
excludes them from the anchor statistics for exactly that reason. Absence of
the field means the operator typed the date.
engine_2026_08_14 blocks are source=extraction - measured, not operator truth.
They are the faithful live read (apply_baseline_filters -> _trim_to_period ->
read_structure) on the 2026-08-13 cache, captured with
AR_FIRST_REACTION_ENABLED off and on. Where read_structure no longer fires,
the values are carried from the 2026-08-13 capture the operator actually
looked at (tools/fidelity/ar_first_reaction_2026-08-13/scan_2026-08-13.txt),
re-resolved to dates; that capture's bar indices are uniformly today's + 1,
verified on the six names that still fire.
